verdict.rationale: Sentry documents that an agent's MCP connection can be scoped to a specific organization or project, which limits what the agent can reach. It also documents Organization Tokens and pasted auth tokens for CLI/API access. However, no evidence shows granular permission scopes, read-only tokens, or agent-specific credential issuance. missing for 10: documented per-token permission scopes (read/write per resource), agent-dedicated credential issuance flow, expiry/revocation controls, independent corroboration.
